meta.rule: Hours and prices only where an official page prints them. Blank means not verified. 'per couple' means cost for 2 adults.
meta.activity_social_rule: Only links seen on or found for the named venue. Instagram/TikTok handles left blank rather than guessed.
meta.last_pass: 2026-11-27 (T17): official pages re-read for all five activities; Mob Museum Thursday hours corrected; Bellagio Fountains verified and added as a sixth activity (F-18 closed).
meta.note: Every activity row now cites the official page it was read from on 2026-11-27. Instagram/TikTok links are the venue's own account; High Roller's Instagram is a dormant official account (last post 2024) - still the official handle.

activities.name: Sphere Las Vegas (The Wizard of Oz / concerts)
activities.exceptions: The 2027 show calendar is not fully published as of 27 Nov 2026. Tickets route through Ticketmaster, not the venue box office. Prices are the vendor's current listing, not a February 2027 rate.
activities.price_note: Sphere does not print a single admission price — it depends on the show. Booking.com's own listing shows 'Admission to The Wizard of Oz at The Sphere' from $131.45 per person; that is a reseller price, not the venue's box office price.
activities.notes: The single most distinctive thing to do in Las Vegas right now. Book only once the 2027 calendar is live.

activities.name: High Roller Observation Wheel
activities.hours: Opens 12:30 PM; daytime tickets 12:00-5:59 PM, anytime tickets from 6:00 PM
activities.exceptions: One rotation takes 30 minutes; allow about an hour including boarding. Happy Half Hour is 21+ and its own ticket.
activities.price_note: Official High Roller FAQ: adult daytime (12-5:59 PM) $23.50, adult anytime (from 6 PM) $34.75, Happy Half Hour (21+) $60 - each plus taxes and fees. Two adults = $47.00 daytime or $69.50 anytime before tax.
activities.notes: Happy Half Hour is an open-bar cabin with a bartender for the full rotation.

activities.name: The Mob Museum
activities.hours: Museum 9:00 AM-9:00 PM daily (Thu also 9-9) · The Underground 11:00 AM-11:00 PM (to midnight Fri-Sat)
activities.exceptions: Hours subject to change; the museum publishes early-closure notices (e.g. Thanksgiving Day: museum 9 AM-4 PM, Underground 11 AM-5 PM). Thursday is a full 9-9 day - an earlier version of this row said Thursday closed at 4 PM; the museum's own hours table on 27 Nov 2026 shows 9 a.m.-9 p.m. all seven days.
activities.price_note: Official ticketing page (admission.themobmuseum.org): General Admission $37.95 per adult, includes The Underground. Two adults = $75.90. Deluxe Pass $49.95 pp, Premier Pass $54.95 pp (morning and evening arrival discounts save $7 online).
activities.notes: A morning-arrival discount and an evening-arrival discount are offered online only on the Premier Pass.

activities.name: The Neon Museum
activities.hours: Sep-May 3:00 PM-11:00 PM daily (last entry 10:00 PM). Jun-Aug 8:00 PM-midnight.
activities.exceptions: From 1 Jan 2027 a single '2027 Admission' replaces the separate daytime/evening tickets and is valid across operating hours. Box office closes one hour before the posted closing time.
activities.price_note: Official site: 2027 Admission 'from $21' per person, daily 3-11 PM. Two adults from $42. The 2026 daytime (from $25) and evening (from $35) tickets expire 31 Dec 2026, before the trip. 45-minute guided tours are paid add-ons.
activities.notes: Social handles taken directly from the museum's own site footer. 45-minute guided History and Movies tours are add-ons.

activities.name: Fremont Street Experience
activities.hours: Live music and canopy light shows nightly; published show calendar
activities.exceptions: Free and open to the public. SlotZilla zipline is a separate paid attraction on the same site.
activities.price_note: Free entry. The venue states live concerts and performances run on three stages every night.
activities.notes: Free — the obvious way to keep a downtown evening cheap. SlotZilla zipline is a paid add-on on the same site.

activities.name: Fountains of Bellagio
activities.hours: Mon-Fri: every 30 min 3:00-7:30 PM, every 15 min 8:00 PM-midnight. Sat, Sun & holidays: every 30 min 12:00-7:30 PM, every 15 min 8:00 PM-midnight.
activities.exceptions: Free. The schedule may vary and the outdoor display is subject to cancellation in bad weather.
activities.price_note: The Bellagio page states the show is free for any visitor to enjoy.
activities.booking_hint: No ticket needed - just turn up.
activities.notes: Closes F-18: the official page answered on 27 Nov 2026 and publishes the full daily schedule, so hours are no longer blank.
